column5: A UN news item dated 21/10/2026 says the Sudan war, begun in April 2023 between the army (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), who jointly seized power in a 2021 coup, is in its fourth year; Switzerland's State Secretary calls it a drone war that kills mostly civilians; almost 34 million people need humanitarian support (OCHA) and eight million children are out of school (UNICEF); famine-like conditions persist in Darfur and Kordofan. Geneva consultative talks (the sixth round, after Cairo 06/2024, Djibouti 07/2024, Nouakchott 12/2024, Brussels 06/2025 and Cairo 01/2026) had neither belligerent present; the UN Personal Envoy is Pekka Haavisto; mediation sits with the 'Quad' (US, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt) and the 'Quintet' (AU, IGAD, UN, EU, Arab League).
